title: Access the OmicIDX omicx metadata database
text: Access OmicIDX omics metadata database R omicidxr package provides convenient interface query explore OmicIDX metadata database, comprehensive resource omics dataset metadata. Built top DuckDB, enables fast, efficient queries large-scale genomics metadata without downloading entire database. users GEOmetadb SRAdb, omicidxr offers modern alternative cloud-native access, eliminating need manage large local SQLite files. Metadata coverage 40 million SRA experiments, 8 million GEO samples, 50 million Biosamples, accessible via SQL dplyr syntax without large downloads.

title: Access the OmicIDX omicx metadata database
text: 🚀 Fast queries powered DuckDB’s columnar engine remote Parquet ☁️ Nothing download – queries fetch columns rows need 📌 Version pinning – nightly "latest", dated build, citable monthly release 🔍 Full SQL support plus dplyr/dbplyr integration, tab-completion tables 🧬 SRAdb/GEOmetadb successor – sradb geometadb schemas follow packages’ tables 📊 Comprehensive schemas covering SRA, GEO, BioSample BioProject

text: "latest": nightly build https://omicidx.cancerdatasci.org/data/latest/. "YYYY-MM-DD": dated nightly build, kept 30 days. "YYYY-MM": monthly release HuggingFace (omicidx/omicidx@YYYY-MM).
